cohort: 32 women diagnosed with placenta accreta, increta, or percreta at an unspecified center over a 10-month period
finding: Early identification of risk factors and strategic management are crucial for improving maternal and fetal outcomes in cases of PAS, which has shown an increased incidence.
mod_finding: 75% of women in the study cohort with abnormally invasive placenta had a history of previous caesarean sections.
